memory_candidates.content: When a sub-mode spec requires a confirmation gate to show the RECONCILED outcome of an earlier step (e.g. backlog reconciliation resolving a raw candidate to create/widen/dependency-edge/narrow-scope before the user confirms), position that confirmation gate's own section AFTER the reconciliation section in the document, not inside the earlier 'Interactive Selection' block where the raw candidate was first chosen. Document the overall step ordering once, explicitly, near the first interactive step (e.g. '(a) multiSelect -> (b) per-candidate choice -> [intermediate steps] -> (c) confirmation gate') so a reader does not have to infer it from section order alone. This avoids a mechanical-looking but substantively wrong verification pass where a 'confirmation gate positioned after reconciliation' check would otherwise fail even though the prose says the right thing in the wrong place.
